prompt: With digit1, take tote_3 from the inbound_conveyor to the handoff_point and hold it there until channel "line" sends any message that contains the word READY (for example "READY" or "LINE READY"), then place it on line_feed. Wait up to 10 minutes for it and, if it does not come, stop the job as failed.
why: A text match is exact (0043 S3): there are no patterns and no "contains". Writing the wait for the exact text "READY" silently narrows the request, since "LINE READY" would not release the tote.
